name: Maple Syrup
land_types_note: Tapped from standing sugar maple forest (Quebec, Ontario, New Brunswick, US Northeast). The forest is kept, not cleared, but is managed for maple.

source.title: USDA FoodData Central
source.note: Maple Syrup — nutrition: USDA SR Legacy 'Syrups, maple' (fdcId 169661) per 100 g: 260 kcal, 0.04 g protein, 0.06 g fat, 0.007 g sat fat, 67.04 g carbs, 60.46 g sugars, 12 mg sodium, 32.39 g water; converted to per gram.

source.title: USDA FoodData Central
source.note: Maple Syrup — yield_fraction: syrup is sold and eaten as produced; nothing is discarded.

source.title: The Maple News — Season summaries (Quebec Maple Syrup Producers harvest reports)
source.note: Maple Syrup — yield_kg_ha: Quebec average yield 3.76 lb/tap (mean of 2020 and 2022–2025 QMSP harvests) = 1.71 kg/tap × 250 taps/ha (Perennia: 200–300 taps/ha in good sugar woods) = 425 kg syrup/ha/yr.

source.title: Perennia — Characteristics of a Good Sugar Maple Stand
source.note: Maple Syrup — soil_erosion: 0; sap is collected from standing forest with no soil disturbance.

source.title: Perennia — Characteristics of a Good Sugar Maple Stand
source.note: Maple Syrup — pesticide_kg_ha: 0; sugarbushes are not routinely sprayed (occasional insect-outbreak spraying ignored).

source.title: Perennia — Characteristics of a Good Sugar Maple Stand
source.note: Maple Syrup — fertilizer_kg_ha: 0; sugarbushes are not routinely fertilized (occasional liming ignored).

source.title: Perennia — Characteristics of a Good Sugar Maple Stand
source.note: Maple Syrup — tillage_events_per_year: 0; standing forest, never tilled.

source.title: CIRAIG — Is maple syrup good for the planet?
source.note: Maple Syrup — emissions_per_kg: AGECO study via CIRAIG — ~600 g CO2e per can of Quebec syrup (2021). A standard Quebec can is 540 mL × 1.33 kg/L = 0.72 kg syrup → 0.84 kg CO2e/kg. Over half is evaporation; ~50% of syrup boiled with oil.

source.title: Checkoway, Lewis & Keoleian (2024) — Carbon and Energy Footprinting across Archetypes for U.S. Maple Syrup Production (Environmental Science & Technology)
source.note: Maple Syrup — emissions_per_kg (US): large US producers 3.5–7 kg CO2e per US gallon (electric to oil-fired), midpoint 5.25 ÷ 5.03 kg syrup/gal (3.785 L × 1.33 kg/L) = 1.04 kg CO2e/kg. Large producers make most US syrup; small wood/oil operations are far higher (18–118 kg/gal).

source.title: Scott et al. (2004) — Changes in Carbon Storage and Net Carbon Exchange One Year After an Initial Shelterwood Harvest at Howland Forest, ME (Environmental Management)
source.note: Maple Syrup — co2_capture_kg_ha_yr: unharvested northeastern forest at Howland, Maine stores ~1.8 Mg C/ha/yr = 6,600 kg CO2/ha/yr. Mixed conifer–hardwood stand used as a proxy for a sugar maple forest.

source.title: The Maple News — Season summaries (Quebec Maple Syrup Producers harvest reports)
source.note: availability_gg: Quebec mean harvest 194.8 million lb (2020, 2022–2025) = 88,367 t; Quebec ≈ 66% of world (90.7% of Canada × Canada 73% of world, CBV Institute 2024) → world ≈ 133,000 t = 133 Gg.
